headline: US Administration Proposes New Tariffs on China and EU
summary: The U.S. government has unveiled plans for new tariffs targeting China and the European Union, citing unfair trade practices. This move follows previous legal challenges to broader tariff initiatives earlier in the year.
why: Tariffs increase the cost of imported goods, potentially impacting corporate margins for companies reliant on global supply chains and influencing international trade relations.

impacts.name: Global Manufacturing
impacts.why: Tariffs raise input costs and disrupt established international supply chains.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Trade barriers create uncertainty for multinational corporations and can lead to retaliatory measures, affecting global market sentiment.
